page: Amazon Web Services c9gd.12xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by AWS Graviton ARM64 processors. It features 48 physical cores and 48 vCPUs, operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz with a dedicated CPU allocation and a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 96.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance includes 2850 GB of local NVMe SSD instance store volumes, offering high-speed local storage directly attached to the hardware. It runs on the AWS Nitro hypervisor and delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps. The combination of dedicated ARM64 cores and local NVMe storage provides a balanced profile for workloads requiring both high-frequency integer math and low-latency disk access.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ARM64 architecture and dedicated core model offer high resource density and power efficiency compared to traditional x86 architectures. Since there is no hyperthreading, each of the 48 vCPUs maps to a dedicated physical core, ensuring consistent performance. This configuration is suitable for compute-heavy workloads that also require local scratch space, such as high-performance web serving, distributed analytics, batch processing, and database workloads.
